market_definition: The RTV silicone adhesives market comprises room-temperature-vulcanising silicone adhesives that cure on moisture exposure to form flexible, heat-resistant bonds. It measures sales of one- and two-part bonding products rather than construction sealants. BY CURE CHEMISTRY: Acetoxy Cure, Alkoxy / Neutral Cure, Oxime Cure, Other Cure Systems. BY COMPONENT TYPE: One-Component, Two-Component. BY FORM: Paste, Flowable Liquid. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Consumer Electronics, Automotive Electronics & EV Batteries, Industrial & Power Electronics, Telecom & Data Centers, Medical Devices, Aerospace & Defense, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Heat-cure silicone adhesives; silicone pressure-sensitive adhesives; building and glazing sealants; silicone potting gels and encapsulants. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
